data.title: Bessent to miss Bangkok IMF-World Bank talks on Oct 12–18
data.description: Senior Treasury officials will lead the US delegation to Bangkok’s IMF-World Bank meetings, with debt and growth on the agenda

data.title: Apcom Hero Awards marksits 10th anniversary
data.description: The Australian Embassy and Apcom Foundation recently held a press conference for the upcoming 10th Apcom Hero Awards 2026, an annual award ceremony to honour LGBTI and HIV/Aids advocates, communities and allies who work to safeguard and promote the rights of LGBTI and those affected by HIV/Aids in Asia-Pacific.

data.title: Think pink
data.description: Thailand has long been recognised as one of the world's most LGBTI-friendly countries. That is not an understatement. Not only does the country have progressive policies in support of gender diversity such as the anticipated 2024 marriage equality law and the Gender Equality Act, Thailand also lays a solid foundation for the "Pink Tech" economy.

data.title: The need for climate-ready schools
data.description: Flooding across Thailand is disrupting children's education, with schools forced to close in affected areas and some classrooms being used as temporary shelters. The situation highlights the need to prepare schools for increasingly frequent and severe climate hazards.

data.title: Alleged recruitment fraud trio freed over NACC delay
data.description: Three offenders in the government recruitment fraud case were released from prison yesterday after the National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC) reportedly failed to complete the investigation that would have supported their prosecution.

data.title: Govt mulls how to keep Thais safe
data.description: Labour Minister Julapun Amornvivat has discussed measures to strengthen the safety of about 68,000 Thai workers in Israel amid ongoing security risks, focusing on emergency preparedness, worker protection, and preventing illegal employment.

data.title: Yim Leak family asks UN to hold Thailand to its treaty commitments
data.description: Jared Genser, international counsel to Cambodian businessman Yim Leak and his wife, has asked two UN Special Rapporteurs to issue an urgent appeal to the Thai government over alleged human rights violations involving the family, including their seven-year-old son.

data.title: Floods test Anutin, Chadchart
data.description: The recent Bangkok floods have opened a new political fault line between the national government and City Hall, putting Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul and Bangkok governor Chadchart Sittipunt under scrutiny at the same time.

data.title: A messy situation as City appeal clouds title race
data.description: The Premier League returns to action this week under a deep cloud of uncertainty and confusion following the Manchester City guilty verdict by an independent panel and the club's subsequent appeal.

data.title: Kunlavut leads Thai QF charge
data.description: Top seed Kunlavut Vitidsarn stayed on course for his second World Tour title this year after reaching the quarter-finals of the US$500,000 Arctic Open 2026 in Vantaa, Finland, on Thursday.

data.title: Guru's daily horoscope for Oct 10
data.description: The day of the week you were born on can reveal a lot... Read on.

data.title: An afternoon of strings
data.description: For its latest concert, Sounds Of Wireless, presented by the Royal Bangkok Symphony Music School, turned its attention to an instrument whose expressive power often lies not in volume, but in nuance: the classical guitar.

data.title: A 'heroic' season ends with Beethoven's Eroica
data.description: Late last month, Siam Sinfonietta had its final concert of the 2025/26 season at the splendid King's College Great Hall with a double header of two important works in the symphonic repertoire, Sibelius' Violin Concerto and Beethoven's Third Symphony, the Eroica, both challenging works.

data.title: House panel steps up Webull probe over 393 cases on Oct 9
data.description: Webull Thailand denies failures in its know-your-customer system as a House panel probes suspected laundering and presses the regulator for action

data.title: Thai exchange sets 8am start for global products from Nov 16
data.description: Thailand’s stock exchange will introduce eight trading measures on November 16, including smaller price increments and revised short-selling rules.

data.title: 15,000 global finance leaders head to Thailand for IMF–World Bank 2026 with 9 billion baht boost expected
data.description: The Thai Chamber of Commerce expects Bangkok’s IMF–World Bank meetings to generate 8–9 billion baht as Thailand promotes investment opportunities.

data.title: Thai PBS seeks  audit clarification
data.description: Thai Public Broadcasting Service (Thai PBS) has clarified that it has not received any official audit findings from the State Audit Office (SAO) regarding reports that 10 executives and employees were ordered to pay 85.22 million baht in damages to the state.

data.title: Police widen probe into suspect IDs
data.description: Police are investigating four key suspects in an alleged civil registration fraud network in Chiang Rai, including a Chinese man whose bank accounts and his wife's recorded combined transactions of about 581 million baht.

data.title: Port collapse as Persib strike twice late
data.description: Borzidar Bandovic began his reign as Port head coach with a defeat as his team went down to Persib Bandung 3-1 in the opening Group B game of the Asean Club Championship Shopee Cup at Thammasat Stadium on Thursday night.

data.title: City tops UK readers' poll
data.description: Bangkok has been named the world's best city for 2026, topping Condé Nast Traveller's UK Readers' Choice Awards and winning over UK travellers.

data.title: Krabi eyes boost from Russian tourists
data.description: Nine charter flights linking Krabi to four Russian cities this month will boost tourism and strengthen its role as a gateway to the Andaman coast, Deputy Transport Minister Phattrapong Phattraprasit said.

data.title: Suphajee backs B450 tourism fee plan
data.description: Commerce Minister Suphajee Suthumpun has backed a proposal to impose a 450-baht tourism fee on foreign visitors.

data.title: Ekniti welcomes IMF boost
data.description: Hosting the IMF-World Bank 2026 Meetings will help enhance Thailand's image and strengthen its reputation as a world-class destination, says Deputy Prime Minister and Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas.

data.title: Anutin ready for censure
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has dismissed concerns over an opposition no-confidence motion targeting 18 cabinet ministers, saying the government is ready to answer allegations and explain its performance to the public.

data.title: Ex-PTTEP exec returned in 'Rolls' case
data.description: A former executive of PTT Exploration and Production Plc (PTTEP), accused in a transnational bribery case involving Rolls-Royce, has been brought back to Thailand from Indonesia to face prosecution.

data.title: Major earthquake rocks Panama, triggers tsunami warning
data.description: SANTIAGO DE VERAGUAS (PANAMA) - A magnitude-7.7 earthquake rocked Panama on Friday, unleashing panic in the high-rise capital city and causing buildings to collapse in the center of the country.

data.title: Flydubai co-pilot planned suicide attack on Tel Aviv airport: UAE prosecutor
data.description: DUBAI - The co-pilot who attacked the captain of a flydubai jet last month had planned to crash the plane into Tel Aviv's international airport, the United Arab Emirates' top prosecutor said on Friday.

data.title: Indian jailed in France for leading sadist Nazi cult that tortured girls
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - A Paris court on Friday jailed a young Indian man to 20 years jail for leading a masculinist group that forced young girls, many of them minors, to perform sexual acts and in some cases tortured them.

data.title: B100 commemorative coin for World Bank-IMF event
data.description: The Treasury Department will issue a commemorative coin for the 2026 International Monetary Fund-World Bank meetings, reviving a tradition from the country's first hosting in 1991.

data.title: Hurricane Isaias approaches US Gulf Coast
data.description: PENSACOLA, Florida - Hurricane Isaias strengthened into a major category 3 storm Friday as it barrels towards the US Gulf Coast, the National Hurricane Center said, with landfall expected in Florida, Alabama or Mississippi in the next 24 hours.

data.title: Talks with Iran can only succeed without threats, says president
data.description: ASHGABAT, Turkmenistan - Peace negotiations with Iran would only succeed without “pressure and threats”, Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian said Friday, amid deadlocked efforts to end months of fighting in the Middle East.

data.title: Thai court dismisses detention challenge by Chinese reporter
data.description: A Thai court on Friday dismissed a challenge by a Chinese journalist over his prolonged detention in Bangkok, a day after authorities began proceedings to extradite him to China, his lawyer said.

data.title: EU: Turkey’s human rights record a bar to membership
data.description: TURKEY - The European Union said on Friday it had “serious concerns” about democratic standards in Turkey, warning that a crackdown on rights was further undermining Ankara’s long-stalled bid to join the bloc.

data.title: Thai actors apologise for Bollywood charades clip
data.description: A short clip of two popular Thai boys’ love actors playing a word-guessing game on a talk show has drawn heavy criticism in India, after it was widely shared online there.

data.title: Man City skipper confident club will win appeal
data.description: MANCHESTER, England - Manchester City boss Enzo Maresca said Friday he has absolute faith the club will win its appeal after being found guilty of more than 100 breaches of Premier League financial rules.

data.title: Bangkok train fare subsidies to cost up to B5.8 billion
data.description: The Ministry of Transport will seek cabinet approval next month for a budget of between 5 billion and 5.8 billion baht to subsidise electric train fares ranging from 17 to 45 baht per trip.
